budget_gate: 4 hunters + 1 bytecode verifier + 1 final critic + up to 2 candidate verifiers; if candidates exceed 2, validate in fingerprint order and mark run incomplete for the rest
notes: Round 1, standard profile: 4 hunters (one per boundary group) + 1 bytecode verifier in parallel, then 1 final critic, then fresh verifiers per candidate. No OS-enforced sandbox on this VM: PoCs run only against reviewed public bounty code in disposable copies with dummy data (Foundry 1.9.0 local tests, no mainnet fork, no credentials). Explorer API unreachable from this VM (api.cronoscan.com TCP fail; explorer.cronos.com is a Next.js app with no public source API found), so source comes from the VVS GitHub repos and must be verified against deployed bytecode before any finding is confirmed.
prior_ledgers: none for these contracts (SlowMist 2021 audit read; its N1-N9 are known issues)
program: HackenProof Cronos Smart Contracts (FREE, min rep 50, KYC + PoC required; ONLY Critical $20k-$200k / Extreme $250k and High $500-$20k pay; Medium/Low $0; 24h-from-discovery rule; no submission without user confirmation)
